title: Kamishiro Rui — Operation: Meet Santa!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: While I wait for the others to arrive, I should work on some ideas for our next show...

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: Hi, Ruiiiii!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu? Azusawa?
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello, Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, hello.
I wasn't expecting to see you here today, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. We bumped into each other along the way♪ She said she's meeting Akito and the others here!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What a coincidence. We're meeting here before heading off to take lessons at the Morinomiya Music Academy.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, Emu told me all about that!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's so amazing how you guys get to take lessons at THE Morinomiya Music Academy.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We never would've received the opportunity if it weren't for Emu's brothers.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me!
Can you show Rui the stuff from earlier, Kohane?☆

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Sure, just give me one second.
Let's see... My phone should be...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What are you two talking about...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. These.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: These are... Photos of our Christmas show?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! And she did such an amazing job of taking them! Everything looks so pretty and sparkly!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, the snow and lanterns on the slope are very mystifying.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You even got the blur just right.
It's hard to believe that you took this using your phone...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I have a bit of a talent for this kind of stuff!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But these aren't the only ones I wanted you to see. Would you mind also taking a look at this photo...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Shiraishi, Shinonome and Aoyagi all smiling...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: When I turned to An and the others to say how amazing the show was, they all had these beautiful expressions on their faces!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I couldn't help but take a photo.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: There's also this one...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: After the show, she took a picture with everyone who volunteered to help out!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I think their smiles ended up even brighter and shinier than the lanterns they made!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I made sure to keep a close eye on how the audience reacted throughout the show...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But seeing them all smiling like this does fill me with a sense of relief.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you, Azusawa...
The photos you took are wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They've given me the encouragement I need to get through our grueling lessons at Morinomiya.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, I had a lot of fun as well! I really enjoyed the show, met some new people and got to make a lantern for it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: This is definitely a Christmas I'm never going to forget!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I don't think we could've asked for a better review.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nope☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's like each show we do reminds us of the importance of working together, valuing your friends and reaching an understanding with those around you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland's night show is a perfect example of that!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think I sort of understand what you're trying to say, Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You can only see and experience certain things with the help of your teammates and everyone else who is supporting you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It seems that the rabbit holes for shows and singing both go very deep...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, they do.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I plan on working as hard as I can so that An, the others and I get to keep experiencing amazing things!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We also plan to keep improving and learning as much as we can instead of resting on our laurels.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup☆ So, let's keep doing our best to make lots and lots of people smile!
